name: High-Performance Video Discovery & Browsing
changes: Videos mode performs bounded background discovery after first paint, adding older NNTP header windows until sufficient complete videos are recognized or scan budget is exhausted.
Regroup headers across the entire bounded video scan to recover named multipart videos crossing adjacent page boundaries, with completeness enforced before download.
Recognize MPEG, Windows Media, MPEG transport streams, FLV, 3GP and VOB via subjects and yEnc filename resolution without mistaking archives for video.
Keep complete videos visible/selectable when preview or thumbnail generation fails; show a retryable/error placeholder rather than removing videos.
Use the lightweight header-only Videos path; preserve All Posts opaque-binary reconstruction and other views.
Expose scanned header pages/visible video counts and preserve progressive background polling for appended pages.
regression_guards: Source-level tests for actual classifier and real group_articles with multipart video across window boundaries.
Bounded background video scan with no BODY retrieval, no unsafe incomplete download, refresh generation isolation and page coverage accuracy.
Existing v3.7.30 SAB upgrade, v3.7.29 metadata full sweep and v3.7.27 Downloads, v3.7.26 NNTP search regressions retained.
No new persistent search index or history, no media deletions, no SAB queue modifications.
v3.7.31-only full version gate; older full version gates never run on current version.
preserved: SABnzbd 5.1.3 and SABCTools 9.6.3 pins, download queue, history, providers, services and Windows helpers.
Metadata Server v0.3.3 and Diagnostic Collector v1.0.31 unchanged.
Images, All Posts and Images + Video existing browsing semantics and settings preserved.
